params.linkText: introduced a card acceptance analytics platform

children: that provides actionable supplier payment insights for financial institutions' clients in minutes, the company said Monday.

The new solution is designed to smooth a common pain point for banks and corporates — supplier payments, the company said. With Mastercard Advanced B2B Analytics, issuers can drive commercial card spend at scale, capture additional revenue, and help corporate clients identify opportunities to optimize working capital.
Businesses often have access to vast amounts of data, but it's often fragmented and underutilized, said Marc Pettican, global head of Corporate Solutions at Mastercard

. The new capability combines "powerful insights with our deep commercial payments expertise to help issuers identify where card acceptance can deliver the greatest value, engage suppliers more effectively, and drive measurable growth," he said.
Absa Group and Emirates NBD are among the first financial institutions to offer Advanced B2B Analytics to their clients.

estimates that the new product can help financial institutions deepen client relationships and accelerate commercial card growth, helping to capture a share of the ~$80T addressable B2B payments sector.

title: Mastercard beefs up commercial payments with AI-driven B2B analytics
